sources.name: sum_mul_eq_sub_integral_mul₁
sources.statement:
theorem sum_mul_eq_sub_integral_mul₁ (hc : c 0 = 0) (hc1 : c 1 = 0) (b : ℝ)
    (hf_diff : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 2 b, DifferentiableAt ℝ f t)
    (hf_int : IntegrableOn (deriv f) (Set.Icc 2 b)) :
    ∑ k ∈ Icc 0 ⌊b⌋₊, f k * c k =
      f b * (∑ k ∈ Icc 0 ⌊b⌋₊, c k) - ∫ t in Set.Ioc 2 b, deriv f t * ∑ k ∈ Icc 0 ⌊t⌋₊, c k

sum_PrimePow_eq_sum_sum'
sources.statement:
theorem sum_PrimePow_eq_sum_sum' {R : Type*} [AddCommMonoid R] (f : ℕ → R) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x)
  {N : ℕ} (hN : ⌊log x / log 2⌋₊ ≤ N) :
    ∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊ with IsPrimePow n, f n
      = ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 N, ∑ p ∈ Ioc 0 ⌊x ^ ((1 : ℝ) / k)⌋₊ with p.Prime, f (p ^ k)

sources.name: sum_PrimePow_eq_sum_sum
sources.statement:
theorem sum_PrimePow_eq_sum_sum {R : Type*} [AddCommMonoid R] (f : ℕ → R) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    ∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊ with IsPrimePow n, f n
      = ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 ⌊log x / log 2⌋₊, ∑ p ∈ Ioc 0 ⌊x ^ ((1 : ℝ) / k)⌋₊ with p.Prime, f (p ^ k)

sources.name: psi_eq_sum_theta'
sources.statement:
theorem psi_eq_sum_theta' {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) {N : ℕ} (hN : ⌊log x / log 2⌋₊ ≤ N) :
    ψ x = ∑ n ∈ Icc 1 N, θ (x ^ ((1 : ℝ) / n))

sources.name: psi_eq_sum_theta
sources.statement:
theorem psi_eq_sum_theta {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    ψ x = ∑ n ∈ Icc 1 ⌊log x / log 2⌋₊, θ (x ^ ((1 : ℝ) / n))

sources.name: psi_eq_theta_add_sum_theta'
sources.statement:
theorem psi_eq_theta_add_sum_theta' {x : ℝ} (hx : 2 ≤ x) {N : ℕ} (hN : ⌊log x / log 2⌋₊ ≤ N) :
    ψ x = θ x + ∑ n ∈ Icc 2 N, θ (x ^ ((1 : ℝ) / n))

sources.name: psi_eq_theta_add_sum_theta
sources.statement:
theorem psi_eq_theta_add_sum_theta {x : ℝ} (hx : 2 ≤ x) :
    ψ x = θ x + ∑ n ∈ Icc 2 ⌊log x / log 2⌋₊, θ (x ^ ((1 : ℝ) / n))

sources.name: abs_psi_sub_theta_le_sqrt_mul_log
sources.statement:
theorem abs_psi_sub_theta_le_sqrt_mul_log {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    |ψ x - θ x| ≤ 2 * x.sqrt * x.log
